Shortbread:

1 cup butter, room temperature (preferably active butter)

1/2 cup sugar

2 cups all purpose flour

1/4 teaspoon baking powder

1/2 teaspoon salt

1/2 teaspoon vanilla extract

2 tablespoons (1oz) milk

Cream together the butter and sugar in a mixer. In a separate bowl mix together the flour, salt, and baking powder. Slowly add this to the butter mixture. Add the vanilla and milk. Halve the dough and wrap in plastic wrap and place in the fridge until the dough is solid like a stick of butter.

Preheat the oven to 350 degrees (180c) Lightly flour a surface and roll out to 1/8-1/4" thick. Cut into a large rectangle that will fit in a parchment paper covered cookie sheet, Bake for 10-15 minutes or until the center starts to brown, rotate half way through. Do this to both halves. Set aside until the caramel is done.

Caramel: 2 cups heavy cream

2 1/4 cups sugar

6 tablespoons unsalted butter. (active butter again)

1 1/4 cups light corn syrup

1/2 teaspoon coarse salt

1/2 teaspoon pure vanilla extract

4g 80%+ THC oil

Bring cream, sugar, butter, and corn syrup to a bubble over high heat in a large sauce pan stirring until sugar in dissolved. Lower to medium heat and slowly bring up to 235-240F on a candy thermometer add your THC oil and bring temp up to 248F. Immediately remove from heat and add salt and vanilla. Might need a second set of hands here. Evenly pour and spread caramel over your shortbread rectangles. You can place the caramel back on the warm burner and let the poured caramel solidify a bit then cover again but be careful about your temps. If you're happy with the thickness pour excess caramel in silicon molds or a parchment covered cookie sheet to cut up later. Let the caramel sit for 8 hours. Cut into sizes that make you feel good about your self.

Chocolate:

Google how to temper chocolate or don't, I haven't really noticed a difference and I freeze my twix anyways. Double boiler or a bain-marie. I find two (2) bags of chips work so 24 ounces or so. Melt until it;s creamy and easy to stir and remove from heat but keep your water hot for reheating. Roll your bars in the chocolate and cover completely. Yes this is messy, deal with it however you need to, I just accept that I can't touch anything for a bit. Place the twix on parchment paper (yes you can reuse paper that has been used as long as it's clean.) Put them in a freezer for an hour. I move them to freezer bags and keep in the freezer cause that's how I roll.

Hope this wasn't too complicated, and that you enjoy if you try them out. Any questions shall be answered as best I can. Peace.

I am working on a mini project for a course I'm taking and I need some help to test it out. This is my second iteration, this time without using browser geolocation api.

The ideas is simple: you visit my web application at http://xyverse.com/, write a message and press enter or click the "send message" button. The application should find your IP address, submit a query to a geolocation service in order to find your latitude/longitude, transmit your message with lat/long to all currently connected clients (other people viewing the site) and plot it on the world map for 5 seconds, after which it should be removed from the map.

This all happens in realtime, there is no database/storage in the background and it should be a fun thing to play with.

Anyways, please give it a go and let me know if you find anything wrong with it. Thank you! :)
